name: Nishijima Hayato
source:
In his second year of work, he has become addicted to social networking sites, which he started to use to kill time. 

He has no goals in life, and his life has become a routine of working, going home after work, watching TV, surfing the Internet, and sleeping.

He has a medium build and a medium height, and although he has no particular characteristics, he is strong to a certain extent.

[From [url=http://www.soft-parthenon.com/product/rhen/character.html]official site[/url]]
